newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index fell 18 points or 0.57 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries index closed 0.12 percent higher. Changes, in percent:
Dec 13 Dec 6 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The index fell again in very volatile trading conditions, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary. Falls outnumbered gains by a ratio of more than four to three.
Better performances came from companies involved in the Gawler Craton gold play in South Australia.
Among these, Merritt Mining NL rose five cents to 19.5 cents on speculation regarding recently completed drilling.
Acclaim Exploration NL firmed 1.3 cents to 6.9 cents after buying 17.5 percent of Lynas Gold NL .
Kingstream Resources NL rose 13 cents to 73 cents while Border Gold NL added two cents to 18 cents.
Falls included thinly traded Gindalbie Gold NL, which fell four cents to 30 cents.
Money Mining NL dropped four cents to 28 cents after results from the Granny Venn prospect in Western Australia failed to meet market expectations.
Denehurst Ltd fell two two 12 cents, Pan Pacific Petroleum NL shed 2.5 to 12 and Gondwana Resources NL slipped 0.8 to 4.4 cents.
